description: Main entry point for a Flutter application implementing a healthcare platform with user authentication, navigation routing, and provider state management. It initializes environment variables, sets up routing with guards based on authentication state, and defines the main app widget structure.

classes.name: MyApp
classes.description: Root widget of the Flutter application managing routing and providers. Handles environment error display and dynamic routing based on authentication status.

classes.name: _EnvErrorScreen
classes.description: A widget displaying environment configuration errors, instructing the user on how to fix missing environment variables or setup issues.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Application entry point; initializes environment variables, configures Supabase, and runs the app.

methods.name: _buildRouter
methods.description: Constructs the application's navigation router, including route guards based on authentication state.
